target.title: improve(matrix): prove lifecycle parity across substrates
target.body:
Closes #101054

## What Problem This Solves

Matrix QA needs one lifecycle contract for cold start, idempotent start, restart, stop, and resume so the same behavioral scenarios can run against both the Docker-backed Tuwunel live driver and Crabline's Matrix channel driver.

## Why This Change Was Made

The architecture follows the existing selected-driver boundary:

1. `lifecycle.ts` owns only substrate-neutral state transitions and assertions. It knows that a runtime has a `baseUrl`, but knows nothing about Tuwunel or Crabline.
2. `tuwunel-lifecycle.runtime.ts` wraps the existing Matrix live-driver harness and preserves its resolved port across restart/resume. Its Docker proof is a `.live.test.ts` lane, so intentional live-test selection—not a new environment variable—controls provisioning.
3. Crabline lifecycle proof lives beside `crabline-transport.ts` in QA Lab. It selects `{ channel: "matrix", channelDriver: "crabline" }` and starts through `createQaCrablineTransportAdapter`; qa-matrix contains no Crabline-specific implementation or policy.

The lifecycle contract permits a substrate to return a new endpoint after restart while proving the replaced endpoint is no longer reachable. The same five scenarios and Matrix differential probe run against both selected driver lanes.

## User Impact

No end-user Matrix runtime behavior, configuration, or environment-variable surface changes. Maintainers gain executable lifecycle parity proof without duplicating Crabline transport ownership inside qa-matrix.

## Evidence

- Exact pushed head: `ed2e69752257e8590f79796f1bba20cb11620342`.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwwftb05rnyr7pybc44hnzcg`:
  - `node scripts/test-live.mjs -- extensions/qa-matrix/src/substrate/lifecycle.live.test.ts` passed all five Tuwunel lifecycle scenarios.
  - `pnpm test extensions/qa-lab/src/crabline-transport.lifecycle.e2e.test.ts extensions/qa-matrix/src/substrate/lifecycle.test.ts` passed the adapter-owned Crabline five-scenario proof and three shared controller tests.
  - `pnpm check:changed` passed production/test typechecks, extension lint, dependency/package guards, database-first guard, runtime sidecar guard, and import-cycle checks.
- Production boundary check: `extensions/qa-matrix` has zero Crabline references; Crabline-specific lifecycle setup is confined to the Crabline QA transport adapter test.
- Direct upstream contract inspection: Crabline `0.1.9` owns `startOpenClawCrablineAdapter`, Matrix provider probing, Matrix manifest/config translation, and adapter-owned inbound injection.
- Fresh autoreview thread `019f3905-0a5b-7bb2-a8e9-5fd7707b49a9` completed with no accepted or actionable findings. Earlier thread `019f3901-2886-74d1-bb87-8edeb9ed7755` correctly rejected placing Docker-backed Tuwunel proof in the generic E2E shard; the test moved to the explicit live lane.
- Warning-only known annotation: the Tuwunel live test uses an explicit `mkdtemp` cleanup path because the container writes root-owned files.

Developed with AI assistance. A sanitized agent transcript is available but is not included without explicit approval.
